pure_hero.creat_synergy: Full combo finishers and ultimate moves with matching element creat

hybrid_hero.description: Born with two elemental traits (rare bloodline)
hybrid_hero.dominant_element: Player chooses during character creation which element is primary
hybrid_hero.secondary_element: Provides additional personal attacks/spells for hero only
hybrid_hero.creat_synergy: Full combo finishers with dominant-element creat
hybrid_hero.note: Secondary element does NOT affect creat bonding — it's just extra hero abilities

bonding_system.description: Bond represents the synergy between hero and creat in combat
bonding_system.how_it_works: Hero + creat fight together as a duo, not separately

perfect_bond.condition: Hero's dominant element matches creat's element

compatible_bond.condition: Hero rides/fights with non-matching element creat
compatible_bond.note: Playable but not optimal — missing the 'magic' of perfect sync

mounted_combat.when: Races, boss battles, exploration, story mode
mounted_combat.benefits: Cinematic combo attacks, increased speed, trampling damage

unmounted_combat.description: Hero and creat fight side-by-side as a tag team
tactics: Creat distracts while hero lands critical hits
Hero tanks while creat unleashes elemental attacks

tactical_retreat.action: Hero unmounts, creat retreats to recover
tactical_retreat.hero_solo: Hero holds off boss with personal skills and weapons
tactical_retreat.creat_recovery: Stamina and HP regenerate while out of combat
tactical_retreat.return: Creat rejoins when recovered for final combo phase

examples: Fire: Creat breathes flame → Hero charges through inferno with flaming blade
Water: Creat summons tidal wave → Hero rides wave for crushing impact
Earth: Creat slams ground → Hero leaps from shockwave for aerial strike
Lightning: Creat channels storm → Hero becomes lightning bolt strike
Shadow: Creat creates void → Hero emerges from shadows for assassination
Light: Creat radiates holy aura → Hero's blade becomes beam of light

hero_abilities: Fire attacks: Flame bolt, cinder dash, inferno wave
Shadow abilities: Veil step (stealth), shade slash, fear hex
Water attacks: Tidal wave, ice shard, healing rain
Earth abilities: Stone skin (defense buff), root bind, boulder throw
Lightning attacks: Thunder strike, chain lightning, storm dash
Light abilities: Radiant beam, heal burst, purge debuffs

social_dynamics.hero_relations: All heroes are familiar with each other, part of same world
social_dynamics.hybrid_status: Hybrids are rare but not outcasts or feared
social_dynamics.rivalries: Only appear in competitive modes (PvP, Melee, Faction battles)
social_dynamics.cooperation: In story mode and PvE, all heroes work together regardless of type
social_dynamics.tavern_culture: Heroes gather, share stories, show off creats — no discrimination

creat_shelter.size: Large enough for fully evolved mythical forms
creat_shelter.purpose: Safe resting place when hero is at tavern or doing non-combat activities

creat_behavior.when_hero_away: Creat stays at home base, pacing/sleeping/training
creat_behavior.when_hero_returns: Creat roars/greets, ready for next adventure
creat_behavior.feeding: Regular meals maintain bond and combat readiness
creat_behavior.idle_animations: Sleeping, stretching, playing with training dummy, grooming

tight_dungeons.passive_buff: Elemental aura provides small stat boost

small_pvp_arenas.creat_presence: Trails behind or stands at edge

taverns_social_hubs.reason: Non-dangerous social activities don't require creat backup
taverns_social_hubs.player_choice: Hero can visit tavern, trade, socialize while creat rests

key_principles.always_together: Hero and creat are a fighting duo, not summon-based
key_principles.tactical_depth: Creat can retreat to heal while hero holds the line
key_principles.combo_system: Synchronized finishers are the ultimate expression of bond
key_principles.no_fusion: Hero and creat remain separate beings — partnership, not merger
key_principles.hybrid_clarity: Secondary element is hero-only abilities, doesn't complicate creat bonding
